description: Variation of conditions U0129431 (Approved Drawings), U0129434 NS03 (Mixed Biodiverse Roof), and U0129445 NS13 (Plant Screening) of planning permission 21/1537/FUL to allow for compliance with current Part L requirements of building regulations; including Installation of Air Source Heat Pumps (ASHP); introduction of a new below-ground sprinkler tank and addition of wind catchers to the roof of the General Hall.  Additionally variation of condition U0129436 NS05 (Arboricultural Method Statement_AMS) to allow for additional pruning of trees for site access.
decision_conditions: Thank you for the AMS.  Regarding the ASHPs, as these were proposed within the initial application and details of these have been secured under condition NS08, is this still part of a variation to the proposals? Same with the spinkler tank, is there a reason they cannot be submitted as details under the relevant condition?
